title: Group of Friends Sitting on Bench, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp 1940s black and white snapshot depicting a group of five men and women sitting closely together on a wooden bench outdoors at night. The women are dressed in mid-1940s patterned dresses, including polka dots and floral prints, while the men wear classic suits with wide lapels and ties. The gathering reflects informal middle-class social life in mid-century America.
